pages.text: From the $(l)Outbreak$() phase, the plague can gather into something worse. Afflicted that have killed, standing together, stop and smoke for three seconds, then $(l)coalesce$() into a $(l)Miasma Clot$(). Unburned corpses lying together may do the same instead of rising.$(br2)Fire breaks a coalescence up. Burn the dead, and keep the Afflicted apart.

pages.name: Miasma Clot
pages.text: Slow, weak and foul to breathe near. It drifts toward other clots and Afflicted and takes them in. Grown big enough, it churns loudly and $(l)condenses into a Form$(). Fire hurts it double; smoke tears it apart.

pages.title: Growing
pages.text: A Form is born $(l)Lesser$(). Each kill feeds it: enough, and from the $(l)Black Death$() it grows $(l)Greater$(); from the $(l)Danse Macabre$(), $(l)Pestilent$(). It stops and churns before it grows, and you will hear it.$(br2)Which Form a clot becomes depends on the nearest nest: warrens make Gnawing Masses, wells Choking Shades, pits the Blackened.

pages.title: Hardening
pages.text: A Form learns. Hit it the same way again and again (blade, arrow, spell or blast) and it hardens against that: a dull clank and a puff of grey dust each time. Switch weapons, or $(l)strip$() it: fire, lightning, a consecrated cleaver, or brazier and censer smoke undo all of it.$(br2)Hurt a Form badly, or kill it, near a nest and the nest sends help.

pages.name: Gnawing Mass
pages.text: Bubonic. Rats holding one shape; every quarter of its health it loses, some break away as loose rats.

pages.name: Choking Shade
pages.text: Pneumonic. Draws a long, loud breath, then breathes a line of miasma at you. Step aside when it inhales.

pages.name: The Blackened
pages.text: Septicemic. Quick; its blows sap your strength, and the ground it crosses blights.

pages.name: Mouldhusk
pages.text: The Rot. Slow and tough; it swells, then bursts spores that can give the Rot to anything nearby. Only from the Danse Macabre.
